On Tuesday, May 14th, from 1:00-3:00 pm in 360 Shields Library, join
#maptimeDavis for our workshop on historical mapping using open source
tools including QGIS and R. Learn how to map people and things in the past,
using publicly-available data and open-source software!


Emily Merchant and Michael Mortimer will show how to visualize social
phenomena in geographic space. We will use open-source tools to map
specific moments in the past and map change over time, primarily in North
America from 1701 to the present. We will address the challenges of
historical mapping, including finding historical data, standardizing
metrics over time, and accounting for shifting boundaries.


Software installation, registration and details here:

https://spatial.ucdavis.edu/2019/05/07/maptimedavis-historical-mapping-with-open-source-tools/
